hook: Seven people and a dog in the water beside a burning boat.
narration: Seven people and their dog were in the water, and their boat was on fire.
This was near Gulfport, Mississippi, in May 2022.
Black smoke poured off the boat as they floated in their life jackets.
A Coast Guard Ocean Sentry plane was overhead.
Its crew can drop a packed life raft that inflates on the water.
They dropped one to the group.
The boaters and the dog climbed in while the boat kept burning.
Then a response boat from Station Gulfport reached the raft.
outcome: The boat crew pulled all seven boaters and the dog out of the raft.
title: Burning boat, 7 people and a dog
description:
A Coast Guard HC-144 aircrew dropped a life raft and a Station Gulfport boat crew rescued seven boaters and a dog after their boat caught fire near Gulfport, Mississippi, on May 21, 2022.

Footage: U.S. Coast Guard video courtesy of Aviation Training Center Mobile, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/844271/coast-guard-rescues-7-boaters-vessel-fire-near-gulfport-mississippi
